title: Pearly-white saucer seen on closed-circuit feed at Cape Canaveral
place_text: Cape Canaveral Air Force Station, Florida (feed location unknown)

tellings.quote: But there's a saucer 20 ft across. It was sort of like a modified egg.

plain: Greg Rogers, introduced on a podcast as a NASA doctor (NASA is the US space agency), says that around April or May of 1992 he watched a closed-circuit video feed showing Cape Canaveral Air Force Station, the military launch site in Florida. He says the feed showed a pearly-white saucer about 20 feet across, shaped "sort of like a modified egg." If he is right, an unknown craft was sitting at one of America's most closely watched launch sites.
